summary: Iteration 14 verified the OTP sign-in email theme rewrite and send-failure cleanup in /app/backend/server.py (backend-only request + light login UI smoke). ALL 23 pytest pass (10 new in test_otp_email_theme.py + 13 in test_hera_otp_chat.py). (1) _otp_html SCANNER SAFETY - PASS: unit tests confirm the new template passes _assert_safe_email with the exact production subject, contains NO <a>/<form>/<input>/<textarea>/<select> tags, no href/src, no http:// or https:// URLs at all; negative controls prove the scanner still rejects form tags and non-https links. (2) THEME MARKERS - PASS: #080A18 outer bg, #0F1028 card, #262A4D border, border-radius:20px, Georgia serif HERA wordmark letter-spacing:14px, #F4D35E gold 'AI MANIFESTATION COMPANION' tagline, #A855F7 divider + code chip (34px, letter-spacing:12px), 'Beautiful soul, your journey continues.' copy, #6E6394 footer. (3) ESCAPING - PASS: code rendered via escape() inside the chip; EMAIL_FROM_NAME escaping verified by monkeypatching it to a script tag - output contains <script> not <script>. (4) LIVE SEND - PASS: POST /api/auth/otp/send delivered@resend.dev -> 200 {ok:true} on the public preview URL, proving the new HTML passes the scanner AND the provider accepted it; OTP record persisted with 64-char sha256 code_hash. (5) RESEND REUSE - PASS: second send within 30s returns 200 {ok:true} with IDENTICAL code_hash in mongo and no new otp_log entry (no new email sent). (6) VERIFY E2E - PASS: code_hash overridden per test_credentials.md (sha256(email:code:JWT_SECRET)), POST /api/auth/otp/verify -> 200 access_token + bearer + user.email, OTP record consumed. (7) SEND-FAILURE CLEANUP - PASS twice: unit test monkeypatching send_email to raise shows the OTP record is deleted; AND live-verified when the email provider rate-limited (429) mid-testing - backend returned 502 'Failed to send email' and db.otps had NO leftover record for delivered@resend.dev, so the user is not blocked by the 30s reuse window. (8) LOGIN UI REGRESSION (smoke) - PASS: /login loads, email submit -> 'Check Your Email' OTP screen, wrong code -> 'Invalid code' alert (400). (9) STALE TEST FIXED: test_hera_otp_chat.py::test_send_rate_limited_within_30s asserted 429 within 30s - outdated since the spec'd behavior is reuse-with-200 (server.py:760-762 comment: original login calls send twice); updated to assert reuse, passes.

minor.issue: External email provider (integrations.emergentagent.com) enforces its own rate limit (429 'email rate limit exceeded') independent of the app's otp_log limit; bursts of sends return 502 'Failed to send email'. Limit resets in ~2-3 min. Not an app bug - the new cleanup correctly deletes the OTP record on this path (verified). Consider surfacing a friendlier 429-with-retry-after to the client instead of a generic 502.

react_native_issues.issue: No testID props on email input, OTP input, Sign In, or Verify & Continue buttons - automation must rely on placeholder text ('you@example.com', '• • • •'). Reference: /app/frontend/app/login.tsx:402,422

action_items: No required fixes - the email theme rewrite and send-failure cleanup are verified working end-to-end.
Optional: map provider 429 (rate_limited) to a client-friendly 429 response with retry guidance instead of generic 502 'Failed to send email'.
Optional: add testID props to login screen inputs/buttons for robust automation.
critical_code_review_comments: _otp_html (server.py:710-737): no <a>, no forms/inputs, zero URLs - trivially passes _assert_safe_email G2/G3; escape() applied to both code and EMAIL_FROM_NAME (verified via monkeypatch test). Theme matches spec exactly (dark bg #080A18, card #0F1028/#262A4D/20px radius, Georgia HERA wordmark, gold #F4D35E tagline, #A855F7 chip/divider, #6E6394 footer).

otp_send failure path (server.py:771-776): try/except around send_email deletes the OTP record before re-raising - verified live during a real provider 429: no orphan OTP left, so the 30s reuse window cannot block a user who never received the code. NOTE: the otp_log entry written at line 766 is NOT rolled back on send failure, so failed sends still count toward the 5-per-10-min limit - acceptable anti-abuse tradeoff, minor.

Resend reuse (server.py:759-762): any send within 30s of the last created OTP returns ok without re-sending - matches the spec'd behavior and the original-login double-call comment; the stale iter-12 test asserting 429 was updated accordingly.
Subject line contains the plaintext code ('Your Hera sign-in code: 1234') - passes _CRED_ASK patterns and scanner since it asks for nothing; flagging only as an observation.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_hera_otp_chat.py (updated stale 30s test to resend-reuse + provider-429 skip guard)

success_rate.backend: 100% (23/23 pass: template scanner/theme/escaping unit tests, live send, resend reuse, verify e2e, send-failure cleanup, plus existing OTP/subscription/hera-chat/account suite)
success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (login email -> OTP screen -> invalid-code alert; no red screen, no console errors)

seed_data_creation: OTP for delivered@resend.dev sent/overridden during tests then cleaned up (db.otps emptied for it). TEST_* otp/otp_log documents from debug runs deleted. No user data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email provider (integrations.emergentagent.com) rate-limits aggressively (~bursts of >5 sends in a few minutes -> 429 -> backend 502); wait ~2-3 min between test rounds, and prefer reusing one send via module fixture (see test_otp_email_theme.py sent_otp fixture). Live-send tests skip on 502. Backend runs uvicorn --reload: editing files under /app/backend (including tests/) can trigger a reload and transient Cloudflare 502s - wait ~8s and retry. Server lowercases emails before storing OTPs - always query mongo with email.lower(). OTP override recipe unchanged: sha256(f'{email}:{code}:{JWT_SECRET}') into db.otps.code_hash. Frontend env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL).
rca_of_issue: REVIEWED FIX (verified): user reported OTP email was a plain Arial table off-brand. E1 rewrote _otp_html with the dark HERA theme and added OTP-record cleanup on send failure. Verified: template passes _assert_safe_email (no forms/links/non-https URLs), all theme tokens present, escaping intact, real send to delivered@resend.dev returns 200, resend within 30s reuses code, verify e2e returns access_token, and the failure cleanup works both under monkeypatched failure and a real provider 429 (no orphan OTP left). Mid-run 502 failures observed during testing were the EXTERNAL provider's own rate limit (logs: '429 email rate limit exceeded'), not an app defect; the app handled it exactly as the new code intends.
